== Overview ==

Before using any online features, the console must first verify that it can connect to the internet. To do this, it first contacts a "connection test" server. Both the 3DS and Wii U use the same server. This test usually happens when connecting to the internet in the system settings, but may also be contacted afterwards as well.

The connection test is a simple HTTP request to <code>http://conntest.nintendowifi.net</code>. The server responds back with a simple reply, indicating the test was a success. After completing the HTTP test, the clients then perform a [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NNCS|NAT check]]. The HTTP flow is as follows:

<pre>
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: conntest.nintendowifi.net
Proxy-Authorization: Basic Og==
User-Agent: CTR AC/02
HTTP_X_GAMEID: 00002400
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Connection: Close

</pre>

<pre>
HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Content-type: text/html
X-Organization: Nintendo
Connection: close
Content-Length: 352


            <!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.0 Transitional//EN" "http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml1/DTD/xhtml1-transitional.dtd">
            <html>
            <head>
            <title>HTML Page</title>
            </head>
            <body bgcolor="#FFFFFF">
            This is test.html page
            </body>
            </html>
          
</pre>
